user.title: Add a Kiosk Satellite device
user.description: Choose Configure KSM to set defaults for future devices, or enter a device ADB address to add one.

device_info.title: Configure Kiosk Satellite device

data_description.password: Admin password for Kiosk Satellite's Web UI.
data_description.home_launcher: Important: Enabling Kiosk Satellite as the default launcher requires selecting it on the device screen when prompted (or in Android Settings -> Default apps).

existing_install.title: Kiosk Satellite is already installed
existing_install.description: Kiosk Satellite is already installed on this device. Choose whether to keep that installation (and its settings) or uninstall it and install it fresh.

existing_device_info.title: Connect Kiosk Satellite Manager
existing_device_info.description: Kiosk Satellite is already installed, so its Home Launcher and Home Assistant token settings will be left unchanged. Enter its existing Web UI password so Kiosk Satellite Manager can connect to port 2324 when needed. Home Assistant will collect this device's Name and Area on its next screen.

data_description.password: The existing admin password for Kiosk Satellite's Web UI on port 2324.
